errors.text_span: На графиката е изобразена една линия в син цвят, обозначена с кръгли маркери.
errors.evidence: The chart displays two separate data series: a solid blue line and a series of blue circular markers (a dotted line). The description incorrectly conflates these into a single series described as 'one line... designated with round markers'.
Due to incorrectly identifying only one data series, the description completely omits the existence and trend of the solid blue line, which is a distinct and important feature of the chart.

errors.text_span: Линията започва в точката (2018, около 12600), след което постепенно се увеличава до точката (2022, около 23000).
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly mixes data points from the two different series. It uses the starting value of the dotted line series (around 12,600) and an end value that is an overestimation of the solid line series' end point (which is around 22,500, not 23,000).

errors.text_span: В участъка между 2019 и 2021 линията демонстрира по-стръмна тенденция на нарастване в сравнение с участъка от 2018 до 2019 и от 2021 до 2022.
errors.evidence: This description of the trend is factually incorrect for both data series. For the solid line, the steepest increase is clearly between 2021 and 2022, not 2019-2021 (which includes a flat portion). For the dotted line, the rate of increase is relatively constant throughout the entire period.
